reference_sql:
WITH parents AS (SELECT DISTINCT parent_category FROM categories),
channels AS (SELECT DISTINCT channel FROM orders),
march_lines AS (SELECT c.parent_category, o.channel, COUNT(*) AS n_lines FROM order_lines ol JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01' GROUP BY c.parent_category, o.channel)
SELECT pa.parent_category, ch.channel, COALESCE(m.n_lines, 0) AS n_lines
FROM parents pa
CROSS JOIN channels ch
LEFT JOIN march_lines m ON m.parent_category = pa.parent_category AND m.channel = ch.channel

solver.query:
WITH grid AS (
  SELECT pc.parent_category, ch.channel
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT parent_category FROM categories) pc
  CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('store'), ('web')) AS ch(channel)
), lines_mar AS (
  SELECT c.parent_category, o.channel, COUNT(*) AS n_lines
  FROM order_lines l
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id
  JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY c.parent_category, o.channel
)
SELECT g.parent_category, g.channel, COALESCE(lm.n_lines, 0) AS n_lines
FROM grid g
LEFT JOIN lines_mar lm ON lm.parent_category = g.parent_category AND lm.channel = g.channel
